st.headline: StarHub to move all MyRepublic Mobile customers onto its network
st.teaser: The move follows StarHub's acquisition of MyRepublic's broadband business in 2025.
fullText: SINGAPORE – StarHub will move all of MyRepublic’s 4G and 5G customers onto its network, expanding its share in the Singapore consumer mobile market.
Announced by StarHub on Aug 6, the agreement builds on the two companies’ existing mobile virtual network operator (MVNO) 5G partnership established in 2022.
An MVNO is a mobile service provider that does not own any physical network infrastructure.

It also comes after StarHub completed its acquisition of MyRepublic’s broadband business in August 2025, when it bought the remaining 49.9 per cent stake for $105.2 million. StarHub had acquired an initial 50.1 per cent stake in 2022.
The latest move will involve moving MyRepublic’s 4G customers to StarHub’s network from M1’s.
MyRepublic had been leasing its 4G mobile network from M1 since Sept 2020.

Both telcos did not disclose how many customers would be affected by the deal, or when the transition would be completed, but noted that customers will be contacted by MyRepublic’s customer service team to ensure a smooth network transition.

In a statement, StarHub chief executive Nikhil Eapen, who will be stepping down at the end of the year, said the new partnership with MyRepublic further extends the telco’s “already significant lead in revenue market share as Singapore’s strong number two mobile operator”.
Chief of consumer business group and CEO-designate Matt Williams said: “As the market continues to evolve, we’ll continue to pursue opportunities that strengthen our business.”
MyRepublic will be the second MVNO in as many months to make a network switch.
On June 30, MVNO redONE – which was operating on StarHub’s network – ceased operations. Existing customers were encouraged to switch to StarHub’s low-cost subsidiary eight.

StarHub’s announcement also comes after M1-controlling shareholder Keppel said at its results briefing on July 30 that it is overhauling the telco. This is targeted to cut $70 million in annual costs by 2028 and position the telco for future industry consolidation.

Keppel had been nearing a deal to divest M1’s telecommunications business to Simba Telecom for $1.4 billion, but the move collapsed after Tuas Ltd – the Australian-listed parent company of Simba – said in May that it had terminated an agreement to acquire M1.

cna.headline: US requests Filipino pastor's extradition on sex charges
cna.teaser: US requests Filipino pastor's extradition on sex charges
fullText: MANILA: The United States has formally requested the extradition of a Filipino pastor wanted on sex-trafficking charges, the Philippines' ambassador to Washington said on Thursday (Aug 6).
Apollo Quiboloy , a self-proclaimed "Appointed Son of God" and ally of former President Rodrigo Duterte, was arrested in the Philippines in 2024 on human-trafficking charges.
He faces life in prison if found guilty in the case, which accuses him of using women and child sect members to sell goods and raise funds for his church.
Quiboloy, who pleaded not guilty shortly after his August 2024 arrest, has been held in a Manila jail ever since.

The 2021 US indictment alleges girls and women between the ages of 12 and 25 were recruited as personal assistants for Quiboloy to prepare his meals, clean his residence, give him massages and have sex with him.
On Thursday, Ambassador Jose Manuel Romualdez told AFP the US had formally asked for the pastor to be handed over.
"The formal request has been transmitted to the Dept of Justice," he said via text message, without providing further detail.
The US Embassy and the Philippine Department of Justice did not reply immediately to requests for comment.
Quiboloy was allowed to run for Senate in the country's 2025 midterm elections despite his incarceration and garnered 5,667,438 votes.

Police said following his arrest that Quiboloy's alleged victims were told they were having sex with the "Spirit of God" and were threatened not to tell anyone on pain of being hunted down by "angels of death".
Quiboloy's Kingdom of Jesus Christ church said at the time that members had "freedom of choice" and thus "anything that happens to you ... is your own voluntary will or choice".
The powerful sect claims millions of followers in the mainly Catholic Asian nation and owns a television network.
Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos said in 2024 that the government was not yet looking to extradite Quiboloy because it was "focusing on the cases filed in the Philippines".

economistArticle.title: The Digital Shield: How India's Tech Giants are Weathering the AI Storm
paras: For decades, India’s IT outsourcing firms have served as the back office of the global economy, churning out lines of code and managing legacy databases for Western multinationals. When generative artificial intelligence burst onto the scene, many observers predicted a swift demise for this labor-intensive business model. Skeptics argued that large language models would render entry-level software developers obsolete overnight.

Yet, the anticipated collapse has not materialized; instead, India’s tech titans are mounting a quiet counteroffensive. Major players like TCS, Infosys, and Wipro are rapidly retraining their massive workforces, pivoting from routine maintenance to complex AI integration. Rather than replacing human programmers, AI is being utilized as a collaborative tool to increase speed and reduce turnaround times.

Nonetheless, this technological shift is redefining the hiring landscape, creating a stark divergence between top-tier talent and average graduates. While experienced software architects who can navigate neural networks are in high demand, ordinary coders who rely on basic scripting face dwindling opportunities. The barrier to entry has risen precipitously, leaving many fresh university graduates stranded.

To survive, Indian service providers are moving up the value chain by offering proprietary AI solutions tailored to specific industries. They are no longer just selling cheap labor; they are selling sophisticated digital transformation. This strategic transition requires a deep understanding of domain-specific challenges, from healthcare compliance to financial risk management.

Ultimately, the survival of India's IT sector hinges on its ability to evolve faster than the algorithms can displace it. While the threat of automation remains acute, the sheer scale of global IT demand suggests that human oversight will remain indispensable. The code of the future will be written by machines, but it will still need to be guided, audited, and secured by humans.
economistArticle.cn:
数十年来，印度的IT外包公司一直扮演着全球经济后台部门的角色，为西方跨国公司编写大量代码并管理遗留数据库。当生成式人工智能轰然问世时，许多观察家预测这种劳动密集型的商业模式将迅速消亡。怀疑论者认为，大语言模型将在一夜之间淘汰入门级软件开发人员。
然而，预期的崩溃并未发生；相反，印度的科技巨头正在发起一场悄无声息的反攻。塔塔咨询服务（TCS）、Infosys和Wipro等大公司正在迅速重新培训其庞大的员工队伍，从常规维护转向复杂的AI整合。AI并没有取代人类程序员，而是被用作一种协作工具，以提高速度并缩短周转时间。
尽管如此，这种技术转变正在重新定义招聘格局，在顶尖人才与普通毕业生之间制造了巨大的分歧。虽然能够驾驭神经网络的资深软件架构师需求旺盛，但依赖基础脚本的普通程序员却面临着日益减少的机会。入行门槛急剧上升，使许多刚毕业的大学毕业生陷入困境。
为了生存，印度的服务商正在通过提供针对特定行业的专有AI解决方案，向价值链上游迈进。他们不再仅仅销售廉价劳动力，而是销售复杂的数字化转型。这一战略转型需要对特定领域的挑战有深刻的理解，从医疗合规到金融风险管理。
归根结底，印度IT行业的生存取决于其进化速度是否能快于算法的淘汰速度。尽管自动化的威胁依然严峻，但全球IT需求的巨大规模表明，人类的监督仍将是不可或缺的。未来的代码将由机器编写，但仍需要人类进行引导、审计和保障安全。

gems.s: Ultimately, the survival of India's IT sector hinges on its ability to evolve faster than the algorithms can displace it.
gems.why: This sentence uses the phrasal verb 'hinges on' to express complete dependency, combined with a dynamic comparative structure that pits human adaptability ('evolve faster') against machine progression ('displace it'). This creates a sense of urgency and balance. 这句话利用短语动词“hinges on”来表达完全的依赖性，结合了一个动态的比较结构，将人类的适应力（“evolve faster”）与机器的前进速度（“displace it”）对立起来，营造出一种紧迫感与平衡感。
